info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Procurement Status Update API
info.description: The Procurement Status Update API facilitates the efficient modification of existing procurement records within the enterprise system. This endpoint allows users to revise procurement details such as status changes, providing essential updates to stakeholders involved in the procurement process. Typical consumers include procurement managers and business analysts who need to maintain accurate and timely procurement information. Utilizing this API ensures that procurement data aligns with current operational needs and enhances overall decision-making capabilities.
